extra:
## This work (Р-222)

Queue item 8: Russian 7e one-shots from the owner's catalogue (`3_КБ\_Каталог.csv`). Each unit is one scenario with its own registered book (`book_id` in your brief header) — mostly scenarios written in Russian by Russian authors, published as PDFs (the text is the source: Russian as printed, no `translated` flag; `name.en` only if the book prints it). Read pages with `python -B pipeline/source/pages.py show <book_id> <page>`; check every number and every map on the page image (`pages.py image`). If the PDF has no text layer on some pages, OCR them yourself: `pdftoppm -r 200 -f N -l N -png "<pdf>" <out>` then `tesseract <png> - -l rus`. Find the printed/physical page relation on the page images and report it (the lead sets `offset`); if pages carry no numbers, printed = physical. The owner's KB folder for the scenario (`C:\_Hobby\Yandex.Disk\НРИ\1_Зов Ктулху\3_КБ\Ваншоты\<год> <название>`) may hold his notes, handouts and maps — use them only as a pointer (pictures may be cleaner there), the book is the source. Run tools as `python -B …`; keep scratch files in your own scratchpad subfolder named after your unit.

- Most books of this batch are scans without a text layer (or with a partial one): OCR every page you need yourself (`pdftoppm -r 200 -f N -l N -png "<pdf>" <out>`, `tesseract <png> - -l rus`), and read every number on the page image.
- Dice with lowercase d everywhere, even in quotes (Р-27). If the book is not written for 7e, put the printed stats only as text in the record, no statblock (Р-221).
- Edition: these are 7e scenarios; if a book turns out to be written for another edition or for Pulp, say so at the top of the report (Pulp → `ruleset` "pulp").
- Records — book-scoped `<book_id>/<kind>/<slug>` in `kb/books/<book_id>/<kinds>/`. Scenario record (summary, keeper_info, hook, advice, steps with refs, conclusion with Sanity rewards, tables), every scene retold for play (`arc`), items, handouts, tomes, organizations, characters (statblocks as printed, Р-25; pregenerated investigators are characters of the book), creatures (known Mythos creatures → `instance_of` the shared `coc:creature:*`), places.
- Cities — shared records (Р-190): Grep `kb/locations/` first (Arkham, Innsmouth, Dunwich?, Providence, Boston, Kingsport, New York, Moscow, Leningrad… exist) and never rewrite an existing one — add through proposals. A missing city where your scenario is set you create in `kb/locations/` (never in the book folder) as a new shared record — unless another unit of this plan (table above) is set in the same city: then propose it in your report instead. Places outside a city — under «Окрестности <города>» (Р-209); a scenario without a named city gets a «город сценария» record inside its book (Р-190).
- Maps — `map` with the image (`app/maps/<unit>-<slug>.jpg`) and spots on every printed number/label (Р-206; check each by eye on a crop); every key number gets a place record. List captions — neutral, no spoilers (Р-209). New spells — draft them in your report (`kb/spells` is shared).
- `axes.era` — as printed (1920s, 1930s, modern, other…), `ruleset` "core". Book misprints — `errata` as printed (Р-35); metric units as printed (Russian books are usually metric already).
- Coverage: `checks/20261112-ru-oneshots/<unit>.md` — every heading → record(s), «не взято» with the reason. Proposals: `checks/20261112-ru-oneshots/proposals-<unit>.json`.
